name: Santa Lucía Monteverde Mixtec
world_status: accessible description is silent on stress

earlier_scan.source_named: Only sources are picture dictionaries (Pequeno diccionario ilustrado, SIL L330a PDF read via wayback: no pronunciation/stress notes) and comparative works (Josserand 1983, Auderset et al. 2023).

sources.citation: Ethnologue, entry 'Mixtec, Santa Lucía Monteverde [mdv]' (Wayback snapshot 2016-03-04).
sources.note: No typology line; alternate name Mixteco de Yosonotú; 83% intelligibility with San Esteban Atatláhuca [mib].

sources.citation: SIL Mexico / SIL International catalogue listings for ISO mdv (Wayback snapshots 2015-09-19 of sil.org/resources/search/language/mdv and 2016-10-24 of mexico.sil.org/es/resources/search/code/mdv): 27 items, all literacy primers, alphabet booklets, phrasebook and picture dictionary; no grammar or phonology write-up listed.
sources.note: Bibliographic discovery only; confirms no descriptive SIL publication exists for mdv.

sources.citation: Eberle Leuch, Martin & Vivian Eberle-Cruz (asesores). 2011. Pequeño diccionario ilustrado: Mixteco de Santa Lucía Monteverde. 3a edición (electrónica). México: Instituto Lingüístico de Verano. 44 pp. (SIL Mexico entry 54790)
sources.note: Picture dictionary with a one-paragraph Introducción; no pronunciation notes (grep acento/tono/sílaba nil in text layer).

sources.citation: Instituto Lingüístico de Verano. 2005. Tnuꞌu ndichi ni kakaꞌan ñayɨvɨ neꞌnu / Dichos de los ancianos del pueblo (mixteco de Santa Lucía Monteverde). México: ILV. 16 pp. (SIL Mexico entry 58535)
sources.note: Illustrated sayings only; no linguistic notes.

sources.citation: LingMex: Bibliografía Lingüística de México desde 1970 (El Colegio de México), searches 'Monteverde', 'Yosonotú', 'Putla', 'Agua del Toro' (2026-09-17).
sources.note: No linguistic work on this variety indexed (only false hits on an author surname).

sources.citation: Auderset, Sandra. MixteCoDB (Mixtecan cognate database),, github.com/SAuderset/MixteCoDB (basis of Auderset, Greenhill, DiCanio & Campbell 2023, J. Language Evolution 8:33-63).
sources.note: Doculect SantaLuciaMonteverdeMixtec (sant1439) sourced solely from Josserand 1983 wordlist; no prosodic information.

sources.citation: Carroll, Lucien Serapio. 2015. Ixpantepec Nieves Mixtec Word Prosody. PhD dissertation, UC San Diego; also McKendry 2013 (Edinburgh PhD), Penner 2019, DiCanio & Bennett 2018 preprint in the same folder.
sources.access_detail: copy on file; access check: online with a university library login (also: harvard online access (harvardkey))
sources.note: Monteverde (abbr. Mon, Josserand 'Verd') appears only in the Appendix A variety table and on a map; no stress information for this variety in any of the held Mixtec prosody works (grep).

sources.citation: [Eberle, Martin & Vivian Eberle-Cruz, asesores]. 2008. Kakaꞌan-yo sasau jiin sastia / Hablamos mixteco y español. México: Instituto Lingüístico de Verano. 34 pp. (SIL Mexico entry 58579)
sources.note: Front matter 'El alfabeto mixteco' (pp. v–vi, rendered pages/): vowels, saltillo, consonants, digraphs, nasalization. Silent on stress and on tone.

sources.citation: Eberle, Martin & Vivian Eberle-Cruz (asesores lingüísticos). 2008. Alfabeto del mixteco de Santa Lucía Monteverde, Putla, Oaxaca. Versión preliminar, noviembre de 2008. México: Instituto Lingüístico de Verano, A.C. 11 pp. (SIL Mexico entry 58522; fetched sources via Wayback of sil.org reapdata PDF)
sources.note: Nothing. Image-only PDF read page by page (pages/): six vowels; long (VV), 'quebradas' (VʼV) and 'cortadas' (Vʼ) vowels — 'Las vocales cortadas se presentan en la penúltima sílaba de las palabras' (p.5); consonants; nasal words; 'Los Tonos' p.11: tonal language, three tones (alto marked with acute, bajo with underline, medio unmarked). No mention of acento prosódico / word stress.

sources.citation: Eberle, Martin & Vivian Eberle-Cruz. Unpublished phonology / tone write-up and field notes on Santa Lucía Monteverde Mixtec (SIL Mexico programme, Agua del Toro, c. 2003–2012), if deposited in the SIL Language & Culture Archives.

sources.note: The only linguists who have analysed this variety (authors of all 27 SIL mdv items, incl. the three-tone orthography); any statement on stress/couplet prominence would come from their analysis. No such item appears in the 2015 public SIL listing, so it may be archive-internal.
